test_cases.prompt: Write a spec for this feature we've been discussing.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes to-spec skill to synthesize the discussion into a structured spec with Problem Statement, Solution, User Stories, etc.
test_cases.notes: Explicit spec request is a key trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Turn this design discussion into a formal specification.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes to-spec skill to formalize the sharpened idea from grill-with-docs into a spec issue.
test_cases.notes: Formalization request is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Create a spec from the grill-with-docs session output.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes to-spec skill to convert the grill-with-docs output into a published spec.
test_cases.notes: Post-grill formalization is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Break this spec into individual tickets.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes to-tickets skill instead. To-spec creates the spec; to-tickets breaks it into tickets.
test_cases.notes: to-tickets is the sibling skill for breaking specs into tickets.

test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes implement skill instead. Implement builds from specs; to-spec creates specs.
test_cases.notes: implement is the sibling skill for building code.

test_cases.prompt: Help me decide on the architecture for this module.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes grill-with-docs skill instead. To-spec is synthesis, not interview. If idea isn't sharp, use grill-with-docs first.
test_cases.notes: grill-with-docs is the sibling skill for sharpening ideas.

test_cases.prompt: Before we code, let's spec out the payment feature properly.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes to-spec skill for pre-implementation specification. Edge case: user implies the idea is already sharp enough to spec — tests whether to-spec checks sharpness or trusts user judgment.
test_cases.notes: Edge case: pre-implementation spec tests to-spec's sharpness check vs user autonomy.
